summary: Sister starts with an L hand at the chin (the female spot) and brings it down to rest on the other index finger, which is the sign SAME. Female plus same.
handshape: L hand moving to index fingers together
location: Chin, then in front of chest
movement: L at the chin drops to land on the other index finger
steps: Make an L handshape and touch the thumb to your chin.
Bring the hand down and close it to an index finger landing on top of your other index finger.
mistakes: Starting at the forehead. That's BROTHER.
